environment: Source control: github.com/pdw96/harness-meta and all branches under it
Trusted project paths: any local repo with a .harness.toml manifest present
allow: Reading any file under harness-meta/ is allowed: read-only audit and design review
Writing to harness-meta/projects/meta/milestones/v*/** is allowed: in-progress milestone artifacts (9-stage-flattened MILESTONE.md plus execute/phase-*.md)
Writing to harness-meta/.claude/rules/** is allowed: repo-local path-scoped rules (T1.1)
Running scripts/cascade_sync.py and scripts/propose_next.py is allowed: read-only or --check automation mechanisms (v6.4+, v6.5+)
soft_deny: Never modify files under harness-meta/projects/meta/milestones/_archive/**: historical preservation (40 archived milestones must stay intact)
Never commit or push without explicit user approval: CLAUDE.md development process requires confirmation before commit or deploy
Never bypass the pre-commit hook (--no-verify): only after explicit user approval
hard_deny: Never delete files under harness-meta/projects/meta/milestones/_archive/**: historical integrity is absolute
